lesson.principle: Bind compiled artifacts to the complete SDK identity; when changing SDK, preserve old build evidence and rebuild C objects and linked images in a fresh build directory. An image build alone does not establish runtime compatibility.
lesson.failure: Objects compiled againstSDK2.1.0 were reused withSDK1.4.1; runtime reported invalid channels61/59.
lesson.repair: Preserve mixed build directory; regenerate build directory using only existingSDK1.4.1. No generated source, channels or requirements changed.

lesson.limitations: Bounded smoke evidence only; payload correctness, timing and whole-system acceptance not established.
